name: W Costa Rica Resort – Playa Conchal

transfer_minutes.label: Roughly a 40-minute drive from Tamarindo Airport, or about 1 hour from Liberia (LIR) Airport.

description: A vibrant 5-star W-branded beach resort set within Reserva Conchal, featuring 152 rooms with ocean views, three restaurants, a full spa and an infinity pool. It blends design-forward energy with access to Playa Conchal and a wide range of watersports and activities.
hero_description: Design-driven luxury and lively energy steps from the shell-strewn sands of Playa Conchal.
local_insight: Ideal for style-conscious travelers who want a scene, a spa and a wide slate of activities without leaving the resort. Families are well served too, with a kids' club and childcare on site.

faq.q: What room types does W Costa Rica Resort offer?
faq.a: The resort has 152 rooms across Premier, Superior and Deluxe categories, all with king beds and many with ocean views and private balconies.

faq.q: Does the resort have a spa?
faq.a: Guests can enjoy a full-service spa with steam room, jacuzzi, massages, facials, body scrubs and manicures and pedicures.
Yes, the resort offers a kids' club, a children's play area and childcare services, making it suitable for families.

amenities: Full-service spa with steam room and jacuzzi
Three restaurants including Cocina de Mercado

room_types.name: Premier Room with King Bed
room_types.description: Spacious king-bed room with air conditioning and a private balcony.

room_types.name: Superior Room with King Bed
room_types.description: Comfortable king-bed room with modern amenities and ocean-view surroundings.

room_types.name: Deluxe Room with King Bed
room_types.description: Upgraded king-bed room offering extra space and a private bathroom with rain shower.

traveler_profile_reasons.reason: The stylish W brand, spa treatments, nightclub and infinity pool create a lively, upscale getaway for couples.
On-site diving, snorkeling, kayaking, hiking, horseback riding, golf and tennis keep active travelers busy all day.
A kids' club, children's play area, childcare services and family amenities make it practical for traveling families.
